status_reason: The paradigm and its timing are the paper's (A A A' A', 240-ms images, 80-ms blanks, 60-s limit, 48 scenes once each, alternations on correct trials), but the 48 original photographs are replaced by 12 generated photo-like scene pairs (illustrative, not photographs of real places) and procedural pairs, interest is rated by model describers or a placement rule instead of naive observers, and the spoken report of what changed is a keyed place-and-type report.

original.citation: Rensink, R. A., O'Regan, J. K., & Clark, J. J. (1997). To see or not to see: The need for attention to perceive changes in scenes. Psychological Science, 8(5), 368-373.
original.experiments: Experiment 1 (flicker) and its no-blank control; Experiments 2 (extended display) and 3 (verbal cues) as parameter sets; the six practice trials

assets.what: 12 photo scene pairs (24 JPEG, 4.7 MB) composited by scripts/build_photo_pairs.py from images an image model generated for this project

harbor.base: Photorealistic colour photograph, eye level, soft morning daylight, wide view. A small quiet fishing harbour: a stone quay along the bottom edge, a few moored wooden rowing boats along the left edge, a row of colourful houses along the far shore, and one small white sailboat with its sail up in the middle distance near the centre of the picture, the focal point but occupying only a small part of the frame. No text, no logos.
harbor.removal: Edit this photograph: remove the small white sailboat (hull, mast, sail and reflection) near the centre of the harbour, filling the area with the calm water that would be behind it. Keep everything else in the photograph exactly the same: same framing, houses, rowing boats, quay, light and colours.

dog.removal: Edit this photograph: remove the golden retriever from the middle of the path, filling the area with the gravel path, leaves and trees that would be behind it. Keep everything else in the photograph exactly the same: same framing, benches, trees, light and colours.
